mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, weak labor market conditions reduce growth expectations and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE stays below 5.0% or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Conflicting signals between rising FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and falling UNRATE (improving labor market) create market uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur (FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls) or returns are positive despite the signals.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (personal consumption expenditures) indicates stronger consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show sustained quarterly growth or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4.5%, monetary tightening raises borrowing costs, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS stays below 4.5% or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (personal consumption) and INDPRO (production) signal robust economic expansion, boosting growth expectations and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move together or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising INDPRO (production index) indicates strong economic output, fostering confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase, rising HOUST (housing demand) signals rebuilding confidence and improved economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not post-shock or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
